records.raw_text: Nationwide, the average annual gross sales of franchisees who were in operation during all of 2025 was $1,742,025. Sixty-four (64) franchisees achieved this sales volume or more. The lowest amount of gross sales achieved by a franchisee was $43,724. The highest amount of gross sales achieved by a franchisee was $13,374,992. records.notes: 64 of 208 franchisees (30.77%) met or exceeded the average. pct_above_avg calculated as 64/208.

notes: Item 19 discloses average annual gross sales for calendar year 2025 for franchisees in operation for all of 2025, reported both nationwide and across 10 geographic regional subsets. All values extracted directly from the text with no ambiguity. No company-owned locations were included. The metric reported is gross sales defined as total revenue from sale of goods or services less sales tax, discounts, allowances, and returns. pct_above_avg values were calculated from the disclosed count of franchisees meeting or exceeding the average divided by total cohort outlet_count.
